notes.title: Knights of the Kitchen Table has released!
notes.content:
Knights of the Kitchen Table has released, jump into the action for yourself!  20% off release sale is also live!

Encounter something while you play?  Want to share what you find?  Have a cool screenshot you want to show off?  Do you stream and want to share your playthrough of this game?  Reach out and share or post it on the community page!
